question: What is the meaning of mass fraction of pre-consumer recycled materials out of the total product mass in relation to recycled materials?
data_point: mass fraction of pre-consumer recycled materials out of the total product mass
description:
The mass fraction of pre-consumer recycled materials out of the total product mass refers to the proportion, by mass, of recycled materials that originate from waste material diverted from the manufacturing process, expressed as a percentage of the total product mass. This metric is used to quantify the amount of recycled content in a product, excluding book and claim model, and is essential for assessing the sustainability and environmental impact of the product. <|ENDINPUT>
